turns.agent:
The connected tools don’t support exact resizing and padding without generative editing, so I can’t make that change here without risking changes to the picture or words.

To preserve the existing video and its 8-second timing, download it as `input.mp4` and run this with FFmpeg:

```bash
ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:-2,pad=1080:1920:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=0x000080,setsar=1" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -fps_mode passthrough -an -movflags +faststart tiktok.mp4
```

This creates a **1080 × 1920 vertical MP4**, with the whole picture and title centred, plain navy above and below, no cropping, and no sound.
